|game_text='''0 side — Separatist Uprising'''

Deploy Separatist Council Room and War Has Begun. For remainder of game, Galen, Imperials, and Imperial starships are lost. Your Republic characters and [Episode I] vehicles gain [Separatist]. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy an [Episode I] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if a complete [Separatist] Mission on table.

'''7 side — At War With Itself'''

Immediately, may retrieve up to 3 Force (Force retrieved this way may be taken into hand) once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to take a [Separatist] character, vehicle, or starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power in battles is +X, and whenever you win a battle, opponent loses X Force, where X = the number of complete [Separatist] Missions on table. Flip this card if no complete [Separatist] Missions on table.
